{"result":"To create a migration and deploy it using `mistral-vespa` commands, follow these steps:

1. **Create a migration**:
   ```bash
   uv run mistral-vespa generate-migration --app-dir ./vespa_app initial_schema
   ```
   
   Fill in the generated file with your schema definition, for example:
   ```python
   from mistralai.search.toolkit.embedding import MistralEmbeddingPreset
   from mistralai.search.toolkit.plugins.vespa.app.schemas.app import (
       FieldDefinition,
       IndexingMode,
       SearchMode,
   )
   from mistralai.search.toolkit.plugins.vespa.migration import VespaMigration, create_schema, set_app_name

   class InitialSchema(VespaMigration):
       def migrate(self) -> None:
           set_app_name("mynewproject")

           create_schema(
               name="articles",
               mode=SearchMode.INDEX,
               embedding_model=MistralEmbeddingPreset.MISTRAL_EMBED_DIM_1024,
               indexing_mode=IndexingMode.DOCUMENT_PER_CHUNK,
               default_query_profile_name="hybrid-profile",
               # The standard chunk fields (content, embedding, identity, metadata) are
               # added automatically. `fields` only declares your extra fields.
               fields=[
                   FieldDefinition.TextField(name="title"),
               ],
           )
   ```
   [1]

2. **Deploy the migration**:
   ```bash
   uv run mistral-vespa migrate \
     --app-dir ./vespa_app \
     --config-server http://localhost:19171 \
     --query-port 18080
   ```
   [2]

**Notes:**
- The migration file must be in the `vespa_app/migrations/` directory. [7]
- Migrations are append-only and ordered by timestamp. [7]
- The application name must contain only lowercase letters (`a-z`). [1]

[2] [Local development > Step 3: Deploy from migrations](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/local-development#step-3-deploy-from-migrations:~:text=uv%20run%20mistral%2Dvespa%20migrate%20%5C%20%2D%2Dapp%2Ddir%20.%2Fvespa_app%20%5C%20%2D%2Dconfig%2Dserver%20http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A19171%20%5C%20%2D%2Dquery%2Dport%2018080) — "uv run mistral-vespa migrate \ --app-dir ./vespa_app \ --config-server http://localhost:19171 \ --query-port 18080"
[7] [Anatomy of a Vespa application > Migrations: Build the application package](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/anatomy#migrations-building-the-application-package:~:text=Migrations%20are%20Python%20files%20that%20serve%20as%20the%20source%20of%20truth%20for%20your%20application%20package.) — "Migrations are Python files that serve as the source of truth for your application package."

content.text:
To create and deploy a migration with `mistral-vespa`:

**1. Create a migration**
```bash
uv run mistral-vespa generate-migration --app-dir ./vespa_app initial_schema
```
This scaffolds a migration file in `vespa_app/migrations/`, where you fill in a `VespaMigration` subclass defining your schema (e.g. via `create_schema`, `set_app_name`, `FieldDefinition`).

**2. Deploy it**
```bash
uv run mistral-vespa migrate \
  --app-dir ./vespa_app \
  --config-server http://localhost:19171 \
  --query-port 18080
```

Notes:
- Migrations live in `vespa_app/migrations/`, are append-only, and applied in timestamp order.
- App names must be lowercase letters only (`a-z`).

Sources:
- [Local development — Step 1: Create your first migration](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/local-development#step-1-create-your-first-migration)
- [Local development — Step 3: Deploy from migrations](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/local-development#step-3-deploy-from-migrations)
- [Anatomy of a Vespa application — Migrations](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/anatomy#migrations-building-the-application-package)
